_comment: The Temporal CLI pin (services/temporal/_install.py). Asset keys are <os>_<arch> in the CLI release's spellings. Bump the version, server_version and all checksums together from the official checksums.txt. A new server minor starts every install from an empty Temporal database: at the next start, a database the pinned server minor did not create is deleted with every older CLI file (RFC-0005 E16). A patch bump of the same minor keeps the database.
